title: The Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-26
source: Lineage:MR@ 7.5 ips>R @ 7.5 ips.(Wilson Boswell).  Transfer info:Akai GX636>Apogee Mini Me @24/96>Mini DAC(monitoring/mastering)>Lynx One soundcard>Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44 via 'UV22HR' Apogee algorithim>CD    Transfered and mastered by Matt Smith 5/11

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Betty board sound captures a high‑energy show with killer versions of Good Lovin' and other classics.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as “crystal clear” and comparable to the famed Betty Board, delivering crisp, sweet audio that outshines many personal copies. Fans rave about the strong performances – especially Good Lovin', Love Light, Hurts Me Too and the B.I.O.D.T.L. segment – noting the show’s consistent high energy and tight flow.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are 4‑5 stars, uniformly praising both the musical performance and the pristine soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the audio crisp, crystal clear, sweet and comparable to Betty Board quality; no mention of drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as tight and consistently strong, with seamless transitions that keep the momentum high throughout.
